doc.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
doc.interviewee: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey

title: Jack Carey, Charlie Moore and the fight at Nelta's Hall
summary: Willie E. tells of a night at Nelta's Hall when Charlie Moore got into a brawl and knocked down a fence.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Jack Carey, Ben Ben Matthews playing the drum, Charlie Moore, one of his old friends. Yeah, he's right. We played at a hall one night, they called Nelta's Hall. And then Charlie Moore got in the humbug and look, when they got outside, Willie took a break and chucked that Charlie Moore and knocked a picket fence down.
And Charlie lit out Charlie Moore. What were you after him for Bill? I just remember. I just remember.
And that was all the same, didn't I?
